free.q: Choose the word nearest in meaning to 'meticulous'.
free.e: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail, which is close to 'careful'.

free.q: Nigeria gained independence from Britain in which year?
free.e: Nigeria became an independent nation on October 1, 1960.

free.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'benevolent'.
free.e: Benevolent means kind and generous, so its opposite is 'cruel'.
The correct preposition after 'good' when referring to a subject is 'at'.
